rationale: No existing spec covers the VIEW-MODE dashboard time-range apply + Auto Run flow. dashboard-panel-time-apply-behavior.spec.js tests the Add/Edit-panel mode only (config picker auto-apply + panel editor Apply button, including '24-should not apply when Apply not clicked' which is the editor's still-present Apply). dashboard-variables-auto-run.spec.js tests VARIABLE apply with Auto Run, not TIME RANGE apply. The dev's diff only updated page objects (applyPickedDateTime) and one tooltip assertion; it did not add a spec for the new no-Apply/refresh-to-apply-time-range behavior. Appending time-range tests to the variables spec would create a tag-mismatched Frankenstein spec (different feature area, different tags). run-context/setup-contract designate the new spec_path dashboard-time-range-apply.spec.js and the Dashboards-Panel-Level-DateTime-Config shard. One feature area (Dashboards), no secondary area to flag.
